persons.name: Viṣṇuprasāda
persons.evidence: viṣṇuprasāda ityākhyo vāhujaḥ ... tābhyāṃ tu likhitaṃ

persons.name: Viśvanātha
persons.evidence: gaṇakasya kule jāto viśvanāthaś ca ... tābhyāṃ tu likhitaṃ

date.as_written: yamābhravasubhūśāke śrāvaṇasya pare dale || pañcamyān dasrabhe saumye vṛddhiyoge

notes: The catalogue records only 'Viṣṇuprada Kṣetrī', but the colophon explicitly names two scribes who jointly wrote the manuscript ('tābhyāṃ tu likhitaṃ'): Viṣṇuprasāda (a vāhuja / Kṣatriya) and Viśvanātha (born in the lineage of an astrologer/gaṇaka).
